Main concerns: latency for interactive code completions (~200-300ms target), unpredictable per-token costs for high-frequency editing flows, and single-tenant isolation not required. Quote from CTO: "we need predictable $/active-dev, otherwise team will default to free competitor offer." Trial looks at hosted_api only; no Dedicated/private interest now. SE demo showed quantization options but customer is price-sensitive. Billing confusion — thought free credits would auto-apply to billing rather than require opt-in; risk that they stop after credits. Recent activity indicates they signed up for an OpenAI promo and ran tests this week (lower cost in tiny burst scenarios). Prioritized next steps: push clear cost example per feature, share prompt templates + batching tips, offer 30-day migration credit if they move key usage to Redwood. Keep messaging short and product-oriented.

Cost sensitivity: high on per-active-dev/month. Model preference: small to medium open models with caching; fallback routing not needed now. Security: SSO (SAML) and basic audit logs desired but not blocking. Main risk: competitor switching due to promotional credits and perceived cheaper short-term cost.
